summary: Elemental Royalty Corporation filed a Form 6-K (report of foreign private issuer) announcing its inclusion in the Russell 3000, Russell 2000 and S&P/TSX Global Gold Index effective June 22 and June 26, 2026. The filing is an index inclusion announcement, not a special situation. No transaction, activist campaign, restructuring, or corporate action altering the company's structure or ownership is involved. The company, an emerging mid-tier gold-focused royalty firm, provides no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes. The filing is routine index reconstitution disclosure with no actionable event for special-situations analysis.
